name: OSRS Body Slot Index
description: Equal-weighted, liquidity-capped basket of the most traded body-slot armour across melee, ranged and magic. Median constituent spread 1.80%.
notes: Rune platebody is the clearest illustration of why unit volume is not liquidity: 109,201 units and 4.2B gp traded per day, yet a buy limit of 70 caps one account at 2.7M gp per 4h window. It trades freely and cannot be replicated.
Torag's platebody (0.20B gp/24h, 3.95% spread) fails the volume and spread screens.
This basket loses 3-4 of its 10 seeds to screening, which strips it of the thematic coverage that motivated it. Documented as a negative result rather than papered over by loosening the screen.

The candidate pool is deliberately larger than target_size. Membership is decided each review by liquidity rank with entry/exit buffers, so the pool defines what the basket is ABOUT while the rules decide what it HOLDS. Curation cannot be automated away: the API has no item taxonomy.
